limitations: The initial real-world disconnect cause remains unknown; this fixes a synthetic reproduction of the reported reconnect membership error, not a demonstrated field diagnosis.
No actual user CSV/log files were supplied to the reviewer. Unsupported/localized CSV timestamp formats were not guessed or widened.
Actual Excel COM is unavailable and untested. Mocked sheet composition and previous offline numerical checks do not establish COM operation.
No live M1/S3, PLC, sensor, heater/lamp or production Sequence Save was operated. Windows native probes used owned synthetic windows/files.

Autosave covers all chart-model records and retained run segments through the fixed termination cutoff; it cannot recover observations dropped before plotting, data never received, an unconfirmed Save, forced process termination or power loss.
Both destination failures preserve immutable histories in memory and keep a read-only recovery window. Memory retention is not a disk-persistence guarantee if the process is forcibly killed.
Tk teardown after-callback warnings occurred in test logs despite passing unittest results; do not claim warning-free tests.
Normal-looking stale physical sensor readings cannot be independently proven fresh by CSV timestamps/hashes or planned slice images.
Final control algorithm approval and real equipment application remain explicitly on hold; this code/artifact review does not lift those holds.
